annevk: 1) Is https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/encoding/textdecoder-mistakes.any.js#L387 really correct per spec and 2) if it is, does the spec really intend this? The new test was reviewed in Chromium. 

Both Firefox and Safari fail the new test. The test expects I/O queue from the spec to actually exist on the heap. In Firefox, it doesn't exist on the heap at all.

For many, many years, it hasn't been a practical issue: Web devs haven't experessed a wish to use the decoder after throw.
